staticText: Provider-Quote Childbirth Budget for /tools/childbirth-cost/. It performs arithmetic only on dated amounts entered by the user and must never supply or infer country, city, facility, insurance, government-programme, vaginal-birth or caesarean prices; claim any benefit is free or covered; compare facility quality by price; recommend a delivery mode or facility; or let budgeting delay needed or urgent care. Figure source and date must stay visible. Household assumptions, verbal estimates, written provider quotes and written payer confirmations must remain distinctly labelled. A zero field means no amount entered, not free care. Unexpected clinical care can change costs. Do not store amounts or dates, put them in URLs, send them to analytics, upload, sync or require an account. TXT and PDF exports are local and user initiated.
